paragraphs: In Shabbat 66b: Adda Mari reports Rav Nachman bar Baruch, who reports Rav Ashi bar Avin, who reports Rav Yehudah.
Moed Katan 16 reads Rabbi Nechemyah bar Baruch.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Shabbat 66b explicitly gives Adda Mari → Rav Nachman bar Baruch → Rav Ashi bar Avin → Rav Yehudah. The Moed Katan name variant remains Hyman’s separate report.

The full Shabbat 66b paragraph has Adda Mari → Rav Nachman bar Baruch → Rav Ashi bar Avin → Rav Yehudah. The full Moed Katan 16a paragraph instead has Adda Mari → Nechemyah bar Baruch → Rav Chiyya bar Avin → Rav Yehudah; Nechemyah has no title there. Hyman’s Rabbi Nechemyah form and the two chains remain distinct, without an identity or transmission harmonization.
